blockingFindings: Indexability is not restricted to the exact production URL. apps/www/src/lib/site-url.ts:17-21 and apps/www/next.config.ts:21-23 use an OR between a production environment label and the production URL; APP_ENV=production plus a staging or arbitrary SITE_URL plus NEXT_PUBLIC_ROBOTS_POLICY=index makes that non-production surface indexable. This violates LR-HG-PRODUCTION's only-with-explicit-production-URL condition and the staging fail-closed boundary.

Human refusal is not structurally binding. scripts/lib/launch-evals.mjs:347-422 records disagreements and authority dispositions as unconstrained text, while scripts/record-holdout-eval.mjs:87-92 and scripts/lib/eval-contract.mjs:374-394 derive acceptance without checking for a human refusal or publication hold. A numerically passing record can therefore preserve the text of a refusal while still certifying acceptance, contrary to the governed holdout prompt.
